g.text: The access aisle is not spare tarmac: the ramp comes down there, so it is striped and kept clear.
Two accessible stalls may share one aisle, which is why they are drawn as a pair.
Accessible spaces go on the shortest route to the entrance, not in the far corner.
Counts and dimensions follow the 2010 ADA Standards; the lot is fictional.
on the shortest route to the door
